Starting something brand new is intimidating, especially when it feels like a completely different world, so it is completely normal to feel nervous. Ashley, we are going to start exactly where you are, with no expectations and absolutely no rush. 

Since you are brand new to this, it is always a good idea to check in with your doctor first if you have any health concerns, just to be safe. 

We have you set up with a bodyweight-only plan to start, which means you don't need any equipment or a gym. Today's plan is simply a 20-minute walk at an easy pace to get you moving. How does a gentle walk sound for your first step today?
